name: Travel to Astranaar
summary: Travel to Astranaar is a diplomatic journey dispatched from the elven capital of Darnassus to the heart of Ashenvale. Emissary Valustraa sends adventurers southward to support the night elf settlement of Astranaar, reinforcing mutual ties within the Alliance. Upon arrival, travelers report to Vindicator Palanaar to assist the beleaguered forest dwellers.

sections.title: A Diplomatic Outreach
sections.body: Forging stronger bonds within the Alliance demands active cooperation across vast distances. From Darnassus, Emissary Valustraa arranges for capable adventurers to journey south across the shores and into the ancient canopy of Ashenvale. By offering aid directly to Astranaar, newcomers prove their faction's goodwill and tangible commitment to collective defense.

sections.title: The Road to Ashenvale
sections.body: The path to Astranaar takes travelers away from the crown of Teldrassil, down through the somber coast of Darkshore, and into the dense woodland of Ashenvale. Awaiting them is Vindicator Palanaar, an envoy stationed among the night elves to coordinate efforts and direct capable hands toward the many trials facing Astranaar's defenders.

faq.q: Where does the journey to Astranaar begin?
faq.answer: The mission begins in Darnassus, where Emissary Valustraa requests an able adventurer to travel into Kalimdor's mainland.

faq.q: Who do I report to in Astranaar?
aliases: who to talk to in astranaar
faq.answer: You are directed to speak with Vindicator Palanaar, who coordinates incoming Alliance travelers to assist the local night elves.

faq.q: Why are travelers being sent to Ashenvale?
faq.answer: The journey serves as a demonstration of solidarity within the Alliance, reinforcing Astranaar's local defenses with ready volunteers from afar.
Astranaar is the primary night elf hub situated in central Ashenvale, located directly south of Darkshore on mainland Kalimdor.

faq.q: What route leads from Darnassus to Astranaar?
faq.answer: Travelers depart Teldrassil via Rut'theran Village, sail to Auberdine in Darkshore, and follow the southern road leading into the forests of Ashenvale.

faq.q: What awaits adventurers upon reaching Astranaar?
faq.answer: Vindicator Palanaar welcomes incoming travelers and directs them to aid the local night elf populace with the growing threats encroaching on the surrounding woods.

angles.text: Fulfilling this mission showcases the Alliance's unity, showing distant allies that assistance will cross continents when called upon.
For the night elves, Astranaar represents a vital strategic foothold in Ashenvale, where reinforcements from Darnassus are always welcome.
